verification_evidence.unit: U11 GNOME UI ownership-clear recovery (bounded sub-unit)
verification_evidence.trace: UiProcessController::finished emits helperPidChanged(0); main forwards it to GnomeAdapter::setUiProcess(0). A failed SetUiProcess leaves ready_ true and uiProcessError_ set. The old probe only called discover when not ready, and prepareAcquisition(window) rejected indefinitely until another UI registration or helper rediscovery.
verification_evidence.change: Reuse the existing 3000 ms probe to retry SetUiProcess(0) only when ready, the current desired UI PID is zero, and the preceding registration failed. A newer live PID suppresses clear recovery; successful acknowledgement restores window acquisition. Existing synchronous call timeout and pinned unique owner remain unchanged. No new timer, async queue, state member, dependency, format, or production test hook.
tests_added_or_changed: GnomeAdapterTransportTest::clearFailureRecoversWithoutUiReopen: capability remains blocked before acknowledgement, existing probe recovers without Hello/Bind restart, then an Action/window ticket completes through actual D-Bus transport
GnomeAdapterTransportTest::liveFailureStaysClosedAndNewPidSupersedesClear: live helper registration failure remains blocked past a probe interval; newer live PID is never cleared by stale recovery
GnomeAdapterTransportTest::ownerReplacementRegistersLatestPid: replacement peer receives the latest PID, not stale clear or old helper identity

existing.note: Node is absent from guest, so CMake omitted gnome_ui_ownership_contract; the unchanged extension fixture ran separately using existing host Node.

limitations: Transport regression uses native Qt Wayland but synthetic Shell responses; it is not graphical desktop/tray/hotkey/capture acceptance.
This sub-unit does not establish current installed-package AE17, sanitizer coverage of the new native adapter mode, memory savings, or the 40 MiB goal.
Existing guiless decoder CTest stays unchanged; the new --adapter-transport mode must be run explicitly under native Wayland plus an isolated bus.
The guest test archive is base commit plus owned files, not a committed deployment candidate. Source and binary hashes are retained.
considered_not_built: No symbol-interposed/fake Qt platform name or production platform override: actual Qt Wayland was available in the authorized existing overlay.
No broad rediscovery/rebind on clear errors: only the failed registration needs recovery.
No retry of a live UI PID or asynchronous retry queue: the narrowly requested zero-PID recovery avoids changing live ownership policy and stale-response handling.
No compositor readiness fix, extension edit, UI work, new VM, new package, or new dependency in this unit.
